host.description: Technical name of the host. Property behavior: required for create operations.

inventory_mode.description: Host inventory population mode. Possible values: -1 - (default) disabled; 0 - manual; 1 - automatic.

ipmi_authtype.description: IPMI authentication algorithm. Possible values: -1 - (default) default; 0 - none; 1 - MD2; 2 - MD5; 4 - straight; 5 - OEM; 6 - RMCP+.

ipmi_privilege.description: IPMI privilege level. Possible values: 1 - callback; 2 - (default) user; 3 - operator; 4 - admin; 5 - OEM.

name.description: Visible name of the host. Default: host property value.

monitored_by.description: Source that is used to monitor the host. Possible values: 0 - (default) Zabbix server; 1 - Proxy; 2 - Proxy group.

proxyid.description: ID of the proxy that is used to monitor the host. Property behavior: required if monitored_by is set to "Proxy" (1).

proxy_groupid.description: ID of the proxy group that is used to monitor the host. Property behavior: required if monitored_by is set to "Proxy group" (2).

status.description: Status and function of the host. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled; 1 - disabled.

tls_connect.description: Connections to host. Possible values: 1 - (default) No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate.

tls_accept.description: Connections from host. This is a bitmask field; any sum of possible bitmap values is acceptable (for example, 6 for PSK and certificate). Possible bitmap values: 1 - (default) No encryption; 2 - PSK; 4 - certificate.

tls_psk_identity.description: PSK identity; must be paired with only one PSK (across autoregistration, hosts, and proxies). Do not include sensitive information in the PSK identity, as it is sent unencrypted over the network to inform the receiver which PSK to use. Property behavior: write-only; required if tls_connect is set to "PSK", or tls_accept contains the "PSK" bit.

tls_psk.description: Pre-shared key (PSK); must be at least 32 hex digits. Property behavior: write-only; required if tls_connect is set to "PSK", or tls_accept contains the "PSK" bit.

groups.description: Host groups to add the host to. The host groups must have only the groupid property defined. Parameter behavior: required.

interfaces.description: Interfaces to be created for the host. See the Host interface object (reference/hostinterface/object).

tags.description: Host tags. See Host tag object.

templates.description: Templates to be linked to the host. The templates must have only the templateid property defined.

macros.description: User macros to be created for the host. See the User macro object (reference/usermacro/object).

hostGroupRef.description: Reference to an existing host group by groupid only.

templateRef.description: Reference to an existing template by templateid only.

tag.description: Host tag name. Property behavior: required.

hostInventory.description: Host inventory object. Each property has its own unique ID number, which is used to associate host inventory fields with items.

contact.description: Contact person. Maximum length: depends on the database used (65535 characters for SQL databases, 2048 for Oracle).

date_hw_purchase.description: HW purchase date. Maximum length: 64 characters.

host_networks.description: Host networks. Maximum length: depends on the database used (65535 characters for SQL databases, 2048 for Oracle).

location.description: Location. Maximum length: depends on the database used (65535 characters for SQL databases, 2048 for Oracle).

macaddress_b.description: MAC address B. Maximum length: 64 characters.
